faqSubtitle: Find answers to common questions about TAX-AI
faqAnswer1: TAX-AI is an AI-powered Tax Platform designed for businesses operating in the UAE. It provides real-time, regulation-aware support on Corporate Tax, VAT, and Excise Tax, aligned with the latest rules and guidance from the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA).
faqAnswer2:
TAX-AI currently supports:
- UAE Corporate Tax
- Value Added Tax (VAT)
- Excise Tax

Our system is continuously updated to reflect the latest FTA regulations, guides, clarifications, and Cabinet Decisions.
faqQuestion3: How does the AI Assistant Agent work?
faqAnswer3: The AI Assistant Agent is an intelligent chatbot designed for enterprise use. It answers complex tax queries using natural language, instantly referencing FTA regulations and guidance. It helps your team make informed decisions without manually browsing FTA documentation.
faqQuestion4: Is TAX-AI up to date with the latest tax laws and FTA guidance?
faqAnswer4:
Yes. TAX-AI is updated regularly to include the most recent changes to:
- UAE Corporate Tax Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 and amendments)
- VAT rules and Cabinet Decision updates
- Excise Tax obligations

Our system integrates summaries and interpretations of official FTA publications.
faqQuestion5: Can TAX-AI be used by tax professionals and legal teams?
faqAnswer5:
Absolutely. TAX-AI is built to support:
- In-house tax teams
- Legal counsel
- Compliance officers
- Tax consultants and advisors

It provides quick reference to technical tax language in an easy-to-use conversational format.
faqQuestion6: Is TAX-AI a replacement for tax advisors?
faqAnswer6: No. TAX-AI is an AI-powered assistant designed to augment decision-making. It's not a licensed tax advisor. We recommend consulting with qualified tax professionals for complex or high-risk matters.
faqQuestion7: What makes TAX-AI different from general AI tools like ChatGPT?
faqAnswer7:
TAX-AI is built specifically for UAE tax compliance and is:
- Tuned to FTA-compliant answers only
- Updated regularly with tax circulars, decisions, and bulletins
- Trained to avoid speculation or outdated practices

Unlike generic AI, TAX-AI is focused and domain-specific.
faqQuestion8: Is TAX-AI compliant with UAE and international data privacy regulations?
faqAnswer8: Yes. TAX-AI follows UAE ADGM data protection laws and is GDPR-compliant. All data is processed securely, and no user inputs are used to train external models like OpenAI.
faqQuestion9: Can I integrate TAX-AI into my enterprise systems?
faqAnswer9: Yes. TAX-AI offers enterprise integration options via API or custom interface solutions. Our team can help embed the Assistant Agent into your internal platforms securely.
faqQuestion10: Is there a free trial or demo available?
faqAnswer10: Yes. We offer demo access to explore how the AI Assistant works with sample queries across VAT, Excise, and Corporate Tax.
faqQuestion11: How often is the AI Assistant Agent updated?
faqAnswer11:
Updates are pushed weekly or in real-time when:
- The FTA issues new guides or clarifications
- New Cabinet Decisions or Ministerial Decisions are released
- Legislative changes are officially published

cookies_links_text: We use cookies to improve user experience. Please refer to our Cookie Policy for more details. Our website may link to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices or content.
user_rights_text:
You have rights under applicable laws, including:

faqQuestion12: What happens if I upgrade from monthly to quarterly while my current plan is active?
faqAnswer12: Your upgrade takes effect after your current monthly billing cycle ends. You'll continue using your existing plan until that date.
faqQuestion13: Can I use my remaining messages before upgrading?
faqAnswer13: Yes. You keep full access to your unused monthly messages until your current billing cycle expires.
faqQuestion14: When does my new quarterly plan start?
faqAnswer14:
It starts automatically the day after your monthly plan ends. Example:
→ Monthly plan ends July 31 → Quarterly plan begins August 1.
faqQuestion15: Do unused messages carry over to the new plan?
faqAnswer15: No. Unused messages expire at the end of each billing cycle (monthly or quarterly) and do not transfer.
faqQuestion16: How many messages will I get when my quarterly plan starts?
faqAnswer16: You’ll receive a fresh allocation of 300 messages on the first day of your new quarterly billing cycle.
faqQuestion17: Why can't I use the new plan immediately after upgrading?
faqAnswer17: Message tokens are time-bound to each billing period. Your existing plan must conclude before the new cycle begins.
